landscape.text:
Quantum computing could one day break
widely used public-key cryptography.

Sensitive data can be collected today
and targeted for decryption later.
The time to plan is now.

Cryptography is woven into applications,
cloud services and network connections.

It lives in certificates,
protocols, code and infrastructure.

Hidden dependencies can
complicate even a routine upgrade.

Introducing QGuard Helix, one platform
for the post-quantum transition.

Discover, assess, plan, migrate,
validate, monitor and govern.

Start with the Quantum
Readiness Assessment Engine.

Map assets and dependencies
in the Quantum Exposure Graph.
Build a cryptographic bill of materials.

Prioritize long-lived
data and report the risk.

Build a roadmap in the Migration
Planner, ranked by business criticality.

Map owners, dependencies and blockers.
Estimate costs before work begins.

Track milestones and progress as your
migration moves through each wave.

Rehearse proposed changes against recorded
configurations in the Migration Sandbox.

Use its digital twin to evaluate
compatibility, performance and rollback risks.

Approve supported changes before rollout, then
validate outcomes with post-change evidence.

Compare hybrid options in the Crypto
Agility Engine and Compatibility Lab.

ML-KEM supports post-quantum
key establishment.
ML-DSA and SLH-DSA are signature standards.

Track key lifecycle in QKMS and
certificates through PKI visibility.

Map certificate chains and service
trust from root authority to workload.

PQAuth helps discover identity flows, analyze
tokens, and plan authentication changes.

Use the identity digital twin to
review compatibility before rollout.

Correlate connected runtime telemetry
and track drift across your estate.

Map controls, collect audit
evidence, and track vendor readiness.

Sophia adds AI-assisted analysis
to your security workflow.
The quantum threat is approaching.
Your organization needs a plan.

Securing the present.
Preparing the quantum future.
Explore QGuard Helix. Request a demo.
